newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian crude weaker, Oman differential hear higher.
newsitem.headline: Asian crude weaker, Oman differential hear higher.

text.p: Asian crude prices were weaker on Friday as players moved to wrap up trading for June-loading barrels.
The Oman differential was heard firmer with a western trader selling a cargo to a U.S. major at MPM -12 cents. However, traders said the deal was not confirmed.
Oman was most recently traded into the Bangchak tender at MPM -18 cents.
Traders said Oman cargoes were still available for June but that no real demand was seen. Oman has mostly traded around MPM -20 cents.
